ns2:course.label: Integrated Project
ns2:course.description: Course is the capstone interdisciplinary new product development project course for the Technology & Management Program. Students work in cross-functional teams (joint business and engineering teams) to solve new product development project problems provided by client firms. Because the client firms differ each year, so do the problems. Same as TMGT 461. 2 undergraduate hours. May be repeated to a maximum of 4 hours. Students may register in more than one section per term. Prerequisite: BADM 366, BADM 367
